name: FLOW Beat Link
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Sends each deck's beat, BPM, track, mixer and FX state to FLOW VJ; leads Ableton Link; runs lights over Art-Net.
description:
Rows: Send beat to FLOW (on), Send mixer to FLOW (on), Send track analysis to FLOW (on), Ableton Link from this deck (off, test), Send decks to Ableton (off, test), Lights from this deck (off, test), Send mixer data (test) (off).

Lights: the deck runs the lights itself over Art-Net to a node, no computer; it steps back while FLOW VJ sends Art-Net.

FLOW: UDP 9100: beats, BPM, titles, levels, rekordbox analysis, cues, mixer, Stem FX, loops, Touch FX finger/effect. Link leads Ableton (GPL-2.0-or-later). Reads files; never writes or patches the deck.
